create_joblib_launcher_config: create a JobLibLauncherConf dataclass instance to configure Hydra joblib parallel launcher settings
configure_n_jobs: set the n_jobs parameter on JobLibLauncherConf to control the number of concurrent jobs
set_backend_preference: configure the backend, prefer, and require fields on JobLibLauncherConf to choose process or thread execution
configure_memmapping: set temp_folder, max_nbytes, and mmap_mode on JobLibLauncherConf to control numpy array memory mapping
register_joblib_config: use ConfigStore to register the JobLibLauncherConf under the hydra launcher group as joblib
